"It is good and reassuring to see
widespread recognition come to an
artist who has all the time deserved
it. Mr. Graham Greene, whose first
novel attracted much attention, has
since had far less luck than is his
due. One of the most interesting of
our younger writers, he has a mind
and method very much his own.
he has in high degree the good, old-
fashioned ability to tell an exciting
story."
_I. A. G. StRong in the Spectator.

sodes. This story should have wide
success."
